Reader describes self-made progress. Entire screenshot shows furnished multiroom home,3293550 displayed, shift objective and daily gem indicator. No earning provenance or purchase receipts.

Image-only reader post shows a player governor campaign poster with jobs,housing,transport and environment messaging and a game-voting call to action. Social-overlay elements obscure some poster text. This is player campaign content, not developer roadmap or independent election verification.

Reader claims high Google ranking. Entire screenshot shows autocomplete suggestions including Lagos Life for an earnings query, not ranked search results. Neither search-result rank nor current popularity independently verified.

Reader asks how to repay NPC Mama Nkechi. Two whole screenshots show Food seller/Bae social panel including Ask for Small Money and a money-sent toast requesting repayment. No repayment control or settled ledger shown; relationship is fictional NPC state.

Reader celebrates bottle-service effects at The Library. Full image shows venue, dance-floor crowd and bottle/confetti overlay with Secret bookcase/Lounge tabs. No purchase ledger or audio playback verified.

Reader reports login failure. Entire screenshot shows wrong-password error and no-email recovery instruction via author contact. Visible credentials and account identity are excluded from report and were not used. This verifies historical error wording, not password validity or recovery success.

Reader reports an error beneath author chat-bug acknowledgment. Entire login screenshot says login occurred but browser did not retain it and suggests opening Safari/Chrome or retrying. Session retention cause not independently diagnosed. Author parent requests device/browser details for chat investigation, not proof this login issue was fixed.

Reader offers takeaway. Entire Bank screenshot shows1500050 balance,11M net worth,zero earned today and weekly tax explanation: first1M free,then20%,40% above10M,45% above50M; bets/sales/gifts excluded and Monday reset stated. Historical text only; no actual tax enforcement or current rules verified.

Reader says reload did not help and asks for another link, replying to author reload suggestion. Entire screenshot shows Safari unable-to-open/no-internet message. Network origin, link validity and remediation success remain unverified.

Third-party Grok response explicitly offers a concept. Entire illustrated Nigeria Life mockup shows street market, needs bars, map and activity buttons. It is generated concept artwork, not Lagos Life runtime, released software or author roadmap.

Reader reports it just worked. Entire image shows Look onboarding with skin,hair,outfit controls and visible Continue. This is reader-reported recovery to onboarding, not proof of full signup completion or persistent account.

limitations: Source crops and overlays remain as supplied; missing pixels not reconstructed.
Visible credentials in one historical reader screenshot excluded from safe report and never used.
Historical screen values/messages do not prove current runtime, ledger settlement, causes or remediation.
Player campaign and third-party concept art distinguished from developer commitments.
Known app-only and X Error posts not retried.
